name: ticket-queue
uses: {modelling: {use: modelling}}
parameters:
  pick-per-waiting:
    value: 10
    unit: 1/h
    estimate: true
    description: "Share of the waiting queue picked up for work each hour, when a worker is free."
  finish-per-working:
    value: 2
    unit: 1/h
    estimate: true
    description: "Share of the tickets being worked that are finished each hour."
  workers:
    value: 4
    unit: tickets
    estimate: true
    description: "How many tickets can be worked at once; the most the working stock can hold. Value is a first guess, to be fitted."
stocks:
  tickets-waiting:
    unit: tickets
    description: "Tickets in the queue, not yet picked up for work."
    sensor:
      manual: true
  tickets-working:
    unit: tickets
    description: "Tickets someone is working on right now."
    sensor:
      manual: true
auxiliaries:
  arrivals:
    unit: tickets
    exogenous: true
    description: "How many new tickets reach the queue per hour; set by the outside world and measured."
    sensor:
      manual: true
flows:
  tickets-arrived:
    to: tickets-waiting
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+auxiliary.arrivals]
    equation: auxiliary.arrivals
    description: "New tickets entering the queue; what decides it is how fast tickets arrive."
  tickets-started:
    from: tickets-waiting
    to: tickets-working
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+stock.tickets-waiting, +stock.tickets-working]
    equation: MIN(pick-per-waiting * stock.tickets-waiting, pick-per-waiting * MAX(0, workers - stock.tickets-working))
    description: "Tickets picked up for work; the pick rate times the queue, held to the free places among the workers."
  tickets-finished:
    from: tickets-working
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+stock.tickets-working]
    equation: finish-per-working * stock.tickets-working
    description: "Tickets closed; the finish rate times the tickets being worked."
edits.why: Stocks become counts of tickets with units and descriptions; flows move between them as one chain, each with an equation and description; the arrivals auxiliary takes the count unit since the flow already counts per hour; workers caps the start flow so the queue's growth is explained by the capacity; the uses line adds the modelling loop the check asks for; every sensor is kept.

set.description: New tickets reaching the queue per hour; set by the outside world and measured.

edits.why: The flow tickets-arrived is a rate per hour, so its equation must be in tickets/h, not tickets; this clears equation-units.
The equation falls as tickets-working rises (free places are workers minus working), so the link to the working stock is negative; this clears equation-sign.

name: ticket-queue
uses: {modelling: {use: modelling}}
parameters:
  time-to-pick:
    value: 6m
    estimate: true
    description: how long a ticket waits before someone picks it up, the first fit's 10 picks per waiting ticket per hour
  time-to-finish:
    value: 30m
    estimate: true
    description: how long someone takes to finish a ticket once picked up, the first fit's 2 finishes per working ticket per hour
  tickets-at-once:
    value: 3
    unit: tickets
    estimate: true
    description: how many tickets are worked at the same time, the record's working level tops out near 3
stocks:
  tickets-waiting:
    unit: tickets
    description: tickets raised and not yet picked up, the queue
    sensor:
      manual: true
  tickets-working:
    unit: tickets
    description: tickets picked up and being worked on now
    sensor:
      manual: true
auxiliaries:
  arrivals:
    unit: tickets/h
    exogenous: true
    description: tickets raised per hour from outside, measured, no valve controls them, so they are a disturbance
    sensor:
      manual: true
flows:
  arrive:
    to: tickets-waiting
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+auxiliary.arrivals]
    equation: auxiliary.arrivals
    description: tickets raised from outside, at the measured arrival rate
  start:
    from: tickets-waiting
    to: tickets-working
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+stock.tickets-waiting]
    equation: MIN(stock.tickets-waiting / time-to-pick, tickets-at-once / time-to-finish)
    description: tickets picked up from the queue, each after about time-to-pick, but never faster than tickets-at-once can clear in time-to-finish
  finish:
    from: tickets-working
    unit: tickets
    driven-by: [+stock.tickets-working]
    equation: stock.tickets-working / time-to-finish
    description: tickets finished, each taking time-to-finish of work
